title: Even a Replica Can Fall in Love
titleEnglish: Even a Replica Can Fall in Love
titleNative: レプリカだって、恋をする。
synonyms: Even a Replica Falls in Love

synopsis: On days when Sunao is sick, or not feeling like going to school, she is called to take her place. She was born to this world when Sunao wished to have a substitute. No one knows that she exists, but she tries to do her best for Sunao whenever she is called. One day she talks with Sanada, one of her classmates. They become friends, but soon he notices that she is different from the original Sunao...he was the first one who did. She tells him to talk with her only when she has her hair half-up. Sanada does like she told him, and they enjoy their time together. As they become closer, she realizes that she has special feelings toward Sanada. But she doesn't know what will happen to her...if she, a replica, falls in love. (Source: BookWalker)

synopsis: Riding in a camper, eating delicious food, and enjoying the spectacular view. Saori Furuki was a university student in the engineering department and loved making things. After a car accident, she is reborn as Eline, the daughter of a viscount, However, her family treats her coldly, saying that she is incompetent and can only use magic to produce items, and she is exiled from the country. However, Eline's “alchemy magic” is a magic that has unlimited possibilities when combined with the knowledge from her previous life! Determined to live freely from now on, Eline has created a camper for starters. She can move around, live, and make things as she pleases. Together with Aristy, a martial maid who adores Eline, she begins her adventurous journey with a sense of ease. Eating delicious food, admiring the spectacular scenery, and creating useful things. This is a travel story about riding in a camper and enjoying another world with elegance. (Source: SB Creative, translated)

Super Three Kingdoms-Lord
synopsis: The story is set in the period from the end of the Later Han Dynasty to the Three Kingdoms Period in China. In 184 AD, a brave general of the Nanukoku Kingdom, who contributed to Himiko's unification of Japan, decides to take over the "hegemony" of the Later Han Dynasty. He travels alone to Yushu in the Later Han Dynasty, where he meets the three brothers Liu Bei, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei. He works with these three brothers, but soon learns that Liu Bei is an evil person. One day, Liu Bei tries to kill a criminal to test his new sword, but Pei Yu stops him and even cuts off Liu Bei's head. Guan Yu and Zhang Fei are outraged, but Pei Yu sees and points out that the two were not following Liu Bei out of pure heart. Afterwards, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei witnessed Puo Yu's actions and thoughts and decided to make Puo Yu the new Liu Bei, and the three of them took a new oath of brotherhood in Taoyuan. Note: The story is loosely based on the Three Kingdoms period, using both real and original characters and events from the historical period in Chinese history and folklore of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms.

title: Isekai Tabi wa Niwatorisu to Tomo ni
titleRomaji: Isekai Tabi wa Niwatorisu to Tomo ni
titleNative: 異世界旅はニワトリスと共に
synonyms: Journey to Another World with Chickens!
synopsis: Seven-year-old Otoka remembered his past life memories as a Japanese Salaryman after helping two chicks of a monster resembling a chicken called Niwatorisu in the forest. However, the reality was his family was poor and large. There was no room to raise the chicks entrusted to him by the parent Niwatorisu. Three years passed after overcoming his family's opposition. The chicks grew into splendid female Niwatorisus and began to lay precious eggs. Then, this time, his siblings started targeting those eggs...!? "I'm leaving this house already!" Ten-year-old Otoka carries out a midnight flight together with the Mofumofu strongest Niwatorisus he named Shiro-chan and Kuro-chan. In this way, a free-spirited Isekai journey begins with the cute and these strongest fluffy heroines! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)
